# As-built design summary (generated by tools/report_design.py; do not edit)

Project silkscreen-audio-attachment rev A, 2026-11-09. Frames: KiCad K (x_K = X + 100, y_K = Z + 100) and enclosure E (X, Z; Y up the device). All SMD parts and the jack are on F.Cu (faces +Y, the top); the THT headers are footprints on B.Cu (bodies under the board).

Board outline bbox (K): x 97.475..162.525, y 93.975..107.025; thickness 1.000 mm; 2 copper layers.

## Parts and sourcing

- J1 Hong Cheng HC-PZ254-11.5L-1x4PZ (LCSC C27985189, JLC Extended (no Basic 2.54 mm headers are listed; checked 2026-11-09); stock 44988 on 2026-11-09), pads J6 1/2/3/4: **hand-soldered by the builder**, in bom.csv, not in jlc_bom.csv / jlc_cpl.csv.
- J2 Hong Cheng HC-PZ254-11.5L-1x1PZ (LCSC C27985186, JLC Extended (no Basic 2.54 mm headers are listed; checked 2026-11-09); stock 5114 on 2026-11-09), pads J6 9: **hand-soldered by the builder**, in bom.csv, not in jlc_bom.csv / jlc_cpl.csv.
- J3 Hong Cheng HC-PZ254-11.5L-1x1PZ (LCSC C27985186, JLC Extended (no Basic 2.54 mm headers are listed; checked 2026-11-09); stock 5114 on 2026-11-09), pads J6 12: **hand-soldered by the builder**, in bom.csv, not in jlc_bom.csv / jlc_cpl.csv.
- Header numbers: body 2.5 / post 6.0 / tail 3.0 / pin 0.64 sq. Source: LCSC/JLC product attributes 2026-11-09 (insulation height 2.5 mm, mating pin 6 mm, end pin 3 mm, square pin, brass, gold, 1x4 = C27985189, 1x1 = C27985186); total 11.5 mm from the MPN; 0.64 mm square pin assumed (not listed).
- Post tips at Y 108.10 (underside 116.60 - body 2.5 - post 6.0); J6 face Y 112.82..113.15 -> engagement 4.72..5.05 mm (limits 3.7..6.0). Tails end at Y 119.60 (2.00 above the PCB top).
- Jack SHOU HAN PJ-313D (LCSC C668608, stock 23114): origin E (2.31, 0.0), nose tip x -5.34, body y 117.6..122.6, barrel axis 2.5 above the board top; pad 1 sleeve GND, 2 ring HP_R, 3 tip HP_L.
- ICs (LCSC stock 2026-11-09): U1 TPS7A2033PDBVR C2862740 (122506), U2 PCM5102APWR C107671 (1284), U3 TPA6138A2PWR C183097 (3332), D1 BAT54SLT1G C8592 (221495).
- CPL rotation offsets (EasyEDA footprints, docs/sources/ee_*.json, tools/cpl_offsets.py): SOT-23-5 +180, TSSOP-20/-14 +270, SOT-23 +180, 0603 +0, jack +0.

## Deviations / notes

- The PJ-313D footprint carries its two Ø1.3 positioning pegs (EasyEDA HOLE records) as NPTH holes at footprint (0, -2.655) and (0, +3.358), i.e. E (-0.345, 0) and (5.668, 0): the board has 4 NPTH holes (2 x Ø4.80 screw columns + 2 x Ø1.30 jack pegs), not 2.
